name: fit-thesis-format
description: Vendor-neutral persistent thesis formatting jobs plus backward-compatible low-level tools. Complete delivery requires the same DOCX passing Word and WPS and actual page review.

transport.stdin: one UTF-8 JSON object matching the function parameters
transport.path_resolution: All relative paths resolve against the process working directory, including when --request points to a JSON file in another directory.

exit_codes.0: Operation completed, including delivery_check with needs_review; read delivery_ready and blocking_items.
exit_codes.2: Invalid request, execution failure or failed check

functions.name: fit_thesis_format
functions.description: Run/resume a complete task; submit exact-hash semantic decisions and actual page observations. Basic/legacy tools remain available. No command invents visual review. Only complete dual-engine verification makes delivery_ready true.

scope.description: Only inspect and verify accept scope.

source.description: Existing source DOCX; each stage uses its exact preceding DOCX.

output.description: New DOCX path for apply actions; existing candidate/final DOCX for verify or delivery_check.

mapping.description: Existing reviewed map with source_sha256 matching source. Audit accepts an optional role map. Each action retains its underlying map schema.

report.description: New JSON report path; existing files are never overwritten.

markdown.description: New Markdown report path; required only for audit.

title.description: Optional confirmed thesis title for audit header comparisons.

work_dir.description: New directory for run/prepare; existing job directory for next/submit/resume/verify; optional smoke-test artifact parent for doctor.

chain.description: Optional source-to-final stage-chain JSON for delivery_check; verifiers are replayed.

render_manifest.description: Actual document export report for delivery_check, bound to final DOCX and PDF hashes.

page_manifest.description: All-page PNG manifest for delivery_check, bound to PDF and image hashes.

coverage.description: Complete original-document review record generated by review_plan.py assemble. Required for delivery readiness; all chunks and the applied full style map are rechecked.

result_contract.ok: Compatibility alias for operation_succeeded, never a format-compliance or completion claim.
result_contract.operation_succeeded: The requested operation completed. delivery_check with unresolved blockers still has operation_succeeded=true and delivery_ready=false.
result_contract.delivery_ready: Only true after fresh registered-stage protection, complete final mapping audit, and both Word and WPS page evidence checks on the same DOCX.
result_contract.status: Jobs: created, capability_required, semantic_review_required, visual_review_required, execution_failed, correction_required, no_progress, complete. Legacy status values remain supported.
result_contract.remaining_steps: Explicit remaining coverage, source-chain, native document opening/rendering, page inspection and delivery checks.
result_contract.outputs: Only existing output paths: work_dir/report for prepare, report for delivery_check, output/report/markdown for basic actions. Failed prepare can retain diagnostic partial outputs.
result_contract.error: On failure: code and message. Detailed checks are in result and any published report.
result_contract.checks: Static operation outcome, input-file preservation, and explicit not_run rendering/visual review/native field-update status.
result_contract.limitations: Unperformed work and scope restrictions. Success never implies full structure reconstruction or a completed visual review.
result_contract.blocking_items: delivery_check findings that prevent a completion claim, copied from the freshly generated report.
result_contract.next: Pending semantic decisions, missing capability, or actual page-review tasks with artifact paths and hashes.

safety.mapping_validation: The wrapper checks source_sha256; original tools enforce their own role/region/span schemas and protected-content rules. apply_styles rejects empty paragraph/table/story selections. Partial mappings are supported, but do not satisfy full task coverage.
safety.style_exceptions: Optional mapping.style_overrides={role:{reviewed:true,reason:nonempty string,properties:{...}}} allows explicit layout-only named-style exceptions. The same source-bound map is required for apply and verify; names, outline and content protections are not overrideable. Unrecorded style font/spacing changes fail verification.
safety.tool_success_protocol: Requires explicit boolean ok/passed from basic scripts and operation_succeeded/delivery_ready from workflow scripts. delivery_check exit 3 means the check ran and found blockers, not tool execution failure.
safety.publishing: Basic tools and delivery reports stage into temporary paths and publish exclusively. Delivery reports are copied byte-for-byte without changing fresh hashes. prepare owns its new directory and records partial failures there; it never publishes a formatted DOCX.
safety.review_boundaries: No host-independent protocol can supply missing file access, Python execution, fonts, DOCX rendering or human-equivalent page inspection. The calling AI must report missing capabilities.
safety.job_state: Job original and rule/code hashes remain fixed; state replacement is atomic. No source overwrite. Each correction uses a new attempt directory; old evidence is retained and invalidated.
